column1: # pk-photo-measure (page-kinds-three), 2026-10-14: Vision, Falcon-OCR and PaddleOCR-VL on the 31 photographed pages of PK-PHOTO-SAMPLE-2026-10-14.tsv,
# through the app (a copy of Tools/score-gate taking images, the accurate mode set to one reader for both kinds: Falcon-OCR align, PaddleOCR-VL
# regions, as AccurateReader.route runs them), text through PDFKit. Score as ops/ocrlab/score-bakeoff.py's miss: the truth band's uncontested
# words, letters and digits, matched as a multiset against the page's reading; wrong and missing together. Handwriting scored apart, as there.
# Small sample: 774 print words on 24 pages, 84 handwritten on 6; one page each of a faint table (pk23) and an 1880s ledger (pk33) move it.
# seconds: the run's wall time over 31 pages at the app's concurrency, inside the heavy lock. Not the 67-page table's method (the mean of
# timings.tsv per document: here 8.0 / 216.3 / 44.6 s, which counts each page's wait behind the one-at-a-time model lock). Memory not measured (an RSS sampler sees ~1.3 GB;
# the table's figure is the guard's physical footprint).
# Turned pages: 9 photos are stored a quarter or half turn from upright with no EXIF orientation. The app merges a model's words only onto
# upright Vision lines (alignedReading, the region merge), so on these the model's reading is discarded: identical to Vision. Turned upright
# by hand (upright_* columns, those 9 only), Falcon-OCR's handwriting misses fall 47 -> 28 of 56, PaddleOCR-VL's 47 -> 35, Vision's 47 -> 42.
